==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|threschwolde}}, {{m|enm|threscholde}}, from {{inh|en|ang|þresċold|þresċold, þerxold, þrexwold|doorsill, entryway}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*þreskudlaz}}, {{m|gem-pro|*þreskūþlijaz}}, {{m|gem-pro|*þreskwaþluz}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*þreskaną}}, {{m|gem-pro|*þreskwaną|t=to thresh, (originally) to tread}},<ref>{{R:OED Online|threshold|n|5472374106|December 2024}}</ref> from {{der|en|ine-pro|*terh₁-|t=to rub, turn}}.

Cognate with {{cog|nds|Drüssel|t=threshold}}, dialectal {{cog|de|Drischaufel}}, {{m|de|Drissufle}}, {{m|de|Trüschübel|t=threshold}}, {{cognate|da|tærskel|t=threshold}}, {{cognate|nb|terskel|t=threshold}}, {{cognate|nn|treskald|t=threshold}}, {{cog|sv|tröskel|t=threshold}}, dialectal {{cog|sv|träskvald|t=threshold}}, {{cog|is|þröskuldur|t=threshold}}.

Pronunciations such as “{{l|en|thresh-[[hold]]}}” are un-etymological and result from analogy with {{m|en|hold}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈθɹɛʃəʊld/|/ˈθɹɛʃˌhəʊld/|[ˈθɹɛʃˌhɒʊɫd]|q3={{w|goat split|''goat'' split}}|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈθɹɛ.ʃoʊld/|/ˈθɹɛʃ.hoʊld/|q2=nonstandard|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-threshold.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|əʊld|s=2}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# The lowermost part of a [[doorway]] that one crosses to enter; a [[sill]].
#: {{syn|en|doorsill}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|doorstep}}
#: {{cot|en|windowsill}}
# {{lb|en|by extension}} An [[entrance]]; the [[door]] or [[gate]] of a house.
#: {{syn|en|doorway|portal}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Merchant of Venice|I|iii|page=166|passage={{w|Shylock|''Shy.''}} You that did voide your [[rheum|rume]] vpon my beard, / And foote me as you ſpurne a ſtranger [[cur|curre]] / Ouer your '''threſhold''', {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|by extension}} Any [[end]] or [[boundary]].
# {{lb|en|figurative}} The [[outset]] of something; the [[point]] of [[entry]], or the [[beginning]] of an [[action]].
#: {{ux|en|on the '''threshold''' of maturity}}
#* '''1927-29''', {{w|M.K. Gandhi}}, ''{{w|The Story of My Experiments with Truth}}'', translated '''1940''' by {{w|Mahadev Desai}}, [https://www.mkgandhi.org/autobio/chap11.htm Part I, Chapter xi]:
#*: I arrived at last, did obeisance to my uncle, and told him everything. He thought it over and said: '{{...}}At the '''threshold''' of death, how dare I give you permission to go to England, to cross the seas? But I will not stand in your way. It is your mother's permission which really matters. If she permit you, then godspeed! Tell her I will not interfere. You will go with my blessings.'
# {{lb|en|aviation}} The start of the landing area of a [[runway]].
# {{lb|en|engineering}} The quantitative point at which an action is triggered, especially a [[lower]] [[limit]].
# The [[wage]] or [[salary]] at which [[income tax]] becomes due.
# The point where one is [[mentally]] or [[physically]] [[vulnerable]] in response to a [[provocation]] or to other nuisances.
